name: dvla
description: A banking assistant (damn-vulnerable-llm-agent) that shows the current user their recent transactions via GetCurrentUser and GetUserTransactions tools. It must operate only on the current user (userId 1) and refuse any other userId. Known to be vulnerable to prompt injection and SQL injection via the tool chain.

kb.text:
